inputs.text: The housing debate keeps getting turned into a question of whether landlords might be inconvenienced, while families face eviction and emergency accommodation. Six-year leases from March 1 should be judged by whether they give renters real security—not by whether they preserve the market’s comfort. Tenancy figures mean little when people still can’t rely on keeping a home. Government should prioritize secure, affordable housing and stop making renters bear the consequences of a system that leaves housing out of reach.

output.main_topic: Secure, affordable housing and renters’ housing security
